title: Google News Scraper
description: Scrape Google News by search keyword, topic, or top headlines. No login or API key required.

queries.title: Search Keywords
queries.description: Keywords/phrases to search Google News (e.g. "artificial intelligence", "Tesla earnings").

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Google News topic sections: WORLD, NATION, BUSINESS, TECHNOLOGY, ENTERTAINMENT, SPORTS, SCIENCE, HEALTH.

topHeadlines.title: Top Headlines
topHeadlines.description: If enabled, also fetch the main top-headlines feed.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code for the news edition (e.g. "US", "GB", "IN").

maxArticlesPerFeed.title: Max Articles Per Feed
maxArticlesPerFeed.description: Maximum articles to extract per query/topic/feed. Start small for testing; Google News RSS commonly returns up to about 100 items per feed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Google News RSS is generally open; enable proxies for very large runs.
